label: Theoretical checkpoint
title: Correction stacks are coordinates for observed futures
kind: Exact coordinate theorem and dimensional-program review
summary: A triangular bijection equates finite correction stacks with finite observed futures. A prepared infinite stack has a bounded local CA update, while finite preparation and inherited spatial programs remain separate requirements.
takeaway: Count the distinctions retained jointly, not only the number of correction maps. Recursive spatial program inheritance requires more than transporting a prepared stack.
